original_test_intent: Observe the BMC's earliest serial boot path during a true removal and restoration of platform AC power, proving that the BMC does not execute or emit the specified U-Boot environment-restoration path anywhere in the complete relevant boot transcript.
original_method: Select the unique row; identify SUT/BMC firmware, ttyS0 header/adapter and power-feed topology; drain the host and establish independent recovery; configure the approved serial parameters and begin an unfiltered timestamped capture before AC removal; deassert every required feed for the specified dwell and prove loss of standby power; restore feeds in the approved order; retain capture through the defined BMC-ready boundary; verify continuity and search exact plus approved normalized forms of the forbidden token; restore the requested final host/power state.
manual_activity: A qualified operator attaches the approved ttyS0 fixture, records uninterrupted raw output across the complete authorized AC cycle, proves capture coverage and restores the SUT; the agent may only analyze the supplied artifact.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC model, firmware/build and intended final host/power state
Exact COM/ttyS0 header, pinout, voltage/ground isolation, adapter and serial baud/parity/data/stop/flow settings
All PSU/feed/PDU outlet mapping, safe shutdown, AC-off proof, dwell, restore order and BMC-ready timeout
Required raw capture start/end markers, token matching rules, maintenance approval and independent recovery path
safety_requirements: Verify electrical compatibility and ground/isolation before attaching the serial fixture
Drain workloads and authorize interruption before deasserting all required AC feeds
Start capture before AC loss and maintain it continuously until the approved BMC-ready marker
Preserve raw bytes/timestamps; do not filter during acquisition or equate missing evidence with absence
Stop on console loss, partial feed ambiguity, power/boot fault or incomplete window; do not automatically repeat the cycle
agent_execution_scope: Validate metadata and continuity of the operator-provided serial artifact
Search exact and approved normalized token forms with context and byte offsets
Correlate serial markers with independently supplied AC and readiness timestamps
Do not attach hardware, control AC, fabricate missing intervals, authorize retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve fixture, electrical/serial settings and complete AC power boundary
Approve dwell, sequencing, BMC-ready endpoint and required final state
Define exact case/encoding/token-match policy and minimum capture completeness
Review any token occurrence or incomplete capture and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No remote command can provide the required physical ttyS0 boot trace or AC transition. Grepping an operator artifact is valid only after continuity and window coverage are proven.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator records an unfiltered timestamped ttyS0 stream from before complete AC removal through the approved post-restore BMC-ready marker; analysis searches the preserved artifact for the forbidden token and reports every match/context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: ttyS0/COM capture, AC off/on sequence, forbidden-string absence and 5/10-minute estimate remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an electrically approved serial fixture and independent AC-state timestamps to create a gap-detected raw transcript spanning the entire cold BMC boot, then run a reproducible token search without altering the artifact.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds pinout/electrical safety, all-feed proof, dwell/readiness boundaries, continuity validation, immutable raw evidence and no-retry recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A later SSH journal or a serial capture that starts after boot ROM/U-Boot cannot prove the early restoration path was absent; an empty file proves nothing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: AC cycling interrupts the SUT and an incorrect serial adapter can damage or corrupt the console path; negative evidence depends entirely on a demonstrably complete capture.

project_override_considerations: If an approved rack console server is permanently wired to ttyS0 and a separately controlled PDU can produce authenticated timestamps, those systems may automate capture/control, but the physical and power authorization remains operator-owned. Any token spelling/encoding variants must be listed before analysis.
expected_evidence: Maintenance/operator authorization and all-feed power topology
Raw immutable serial artifact with pre-off, AC-off, AC-on and BMC-ready markers plus gap/continuity report
Exact token search command/version, match count and contextual excerpts
Independent power/readiness timestamps, SEL/host recovery evidence and final state

review_improvement: Preserves the physical cold-boot serial requirement while making absence of the token defensible only from a complete, immutable and safely acquired transcript.
independent_technical_reasoning: The named message is associated with early BMC boot behavior, which can occur before network services and persistent journals are available. Therefore neither an SSH log nor a capture started after AC restoration is equivalent to the source. Proving absence requires evidence that the serial stream was active and gap-free during the entire relevant stage. Complete AC loss also differs from a host shutdown or one-feed removal because standby power may keep the BMC running. These two physical facts make the case manual and critical despite the final text search being trivial to automate.
